# Label Mapping

Maintainers apply labels during triage, and those labels drive the changelog grouping.

| Label | Section |
|---|---|
| `enhancement` | Features |
| `bug` | Fixes |
| `perf` | Performance |
| `docs` | Documentation |
| `chore` | Internal |

An unlabelled pull request falls back to its conventional-commit prefix. When neither is
present the entry needs manual placement before the release is tagged.
